name: ToastAction
purpose: Compact follow-up action rendered within transient toast feedback.
knownLimitations: Avoid required validation, persistent alerts, destructive confirmation, and notification history.

angular.setup:
import { provideVyrnForge } from "@vyrnforge/ui-angular";
// add provideVyrnForge() to bootstrapApplication providers

useWhen: Use when a toast needs one concise follow-up action such as an optional recovery or navigation action.
avoidWhen: Avoid for required validation, persistent alerts, destructive confirmation, or primary business actions.
accessibilityNotes: altText is required and is passed to the underlying button as its aria-label.
aiUsageNotes: Use inside transient toast feedback only; do not substitute it for persistent or required application controls.
